question: Do coherent multi-connection proposals plus per-observation numeric protection improve safe structural credit assignment beyond single-row proposals?
hypothesis: Joint protected updates achieve>=730/768 observed labels,>=122/128 corrected witnesses,0 loss of originally valid predictions, AND>=16 more correct observations than protected single-row updates at the same8192 current/trial evaluation budget. Any condition missed is a frozen negative, even if both methods improve relative to WSP16's smaller budget.

frozen_design.tasks: All32 five-label signatures x seeds17,29,43,71, initialized with the unchanged WSP15 strict1024-proposal circuit. Actual context3 label is opposite that initial prediction, as in unchanged WSP16. No filtering.
frozen_design.capacity: same6 NAND sites/75 binary synaptic scalars. Five per-observation protection activity bits computed numerically from initially valid predictions; these are additional task state and counted. Six examples externally retained for replay and counted.
frozen_design.budget: 8192 proposals per arm/task, no early stopping, same current and candidate six-example forward evaluations for every arm. This is8x WSP16's adaptation budget, explicitly a NEW frozen DEV experiment, not a retuning/replacement of its negative. Joint proposals touch up to3 rows versus1 for single; report actual touched coordinates/row writes, and do NOT claim equal parameter-update cost or whole-process superiority.
frozen_design.proposal: Evidence-independent noise supplies a single random row/source and a random NAND site with two legal source addresses every step. On even steps joint policy simultaneously writes that site's two incoming one-hot rows and directs output to it; on odd steps it uses the supplied single-row proposal. Single controls always use the same supplied single-row proposal. All arms draw identical noise fields. Python may schedule proposals from noise/step only, never task outcomes. Numeric reward and masked writes choose the accepted graph.
frozen_design.protection: Freeze a5-bit activity mask of which original observations the initial circuit already gets right. Numeric reward permits total-error nonincrease AND zero proposed mismatch on every protected observation. Unprotected neutral comparator uses only total-error nonincrease. No target identity, hidden label, symbolic program or external task-specific graph choice enters candidate dynamics.
frozen_design.references: Unchanged WSP16 exact symbolic/precompiled/converged conventional results on identical task observations, source/input identity verified. All produce768/768; no superiority over these controls claimed. Existing WSP19 whole-process cost negative preserved.
frozen_design.hidden: Contexts5,6; exhaustive4 compatible assignments per task, each evidence-only arm exactly512/1024. No unfamiliar-mechanism transfer claim.
frozen_design.stop: Fixed8192 proposals per task/arm; hosted job30minute timeout; no budget/seed/policy/threshold changes after primary results.

classification_rules.supported_dev: all frozen accuracy/recovery/retention/gain conditions and custody hold
classification_rules.negative: any threshold missed with valid controls
classification_rules.invalid: leakage,external outcome-conditioned proposal/graph choice, changed protocol or source/custody failure
classification_rules.scientific_pass: Unavailable without independent matched strongest comparison; manually designed stochastic structural-search rule, public DEV only
